title: GLACE tiles – Sentinel-1 Composites on MGRS squares (10 m)
description: The GLACE composites on 10 km MGRS grid squares in their own UTM zone at 10 m grid spacing, one item per square and year. Each item carries twelve single-band Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs: coherence and backscatter in VV and VH, and for each of the four a contributing-observations count and a composite quality map. Stored values are linear; the renders declare the decibel conversion (`10*log10(x)`) for display. Search the tiles with the item index `items.parquet`.
sci:citation: Gentner, L. Q. (2026). GLACE Alps (Version 1.0) [Data set]. LaRS – Language Repository of Switzerland. https://doi.org/10.48656/60er-3j55

providers.name: European Space Agency / Copernicus
providers.description: Operates the Sentinel-1 mission and distributes the SLC data these composites are derived from, through the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.

providers.name: University of Zurich, Department of Geography
providers.description: Produced the composites from Copernicus Sentinel-1 SLC data: burst extraction, coherence estimation, radiometric terrain correction and local resolution weighted compositing. Derived the annual mosaics and maintains this catalog.

coh12_vv.title: Coherence VV
coh12_vv.description: 12-day repeat-pass interferometric coherence, co-polarized (VV), composited with local resolution weighting over the year's summer window on the 10 m MGRS grid. Dimensionless, in [0, 1].

coh12_vv_qa_num.title: Coherence VV – Contributing Observations
coh12_vv_qa_num.description: Number of acquisitions that contributed to the Coherence VV composite with a non-zero resolution weight.

coh12_vv_qa_cqm.title: Coherence VV – Composite Quality Map
coh12_vv_qa_cqm.description: Composite quality of the Coherence VV composite: the local resolution of the weighted composite, where higher is better resolved. Linear scaling; the decibel conversion is declared in the collection's renders.

coh12_vh.title: Coherence VH
coh12_vh.description: 12-day repeat-pass interferometric coherence, cross-polarized (VH), composited with local resolution weighting over the year's summer window on the 10 m MGRS grid. Dimensionless, in [0, 1].

coh12_vh_qa_num.title: Coherence VH – Contributing Observations

rtc_vv.title: Backscatter VV
rtc_vv.description: Radiometrically terrain-corrected gamma-nought backscatter, co-polarized (VV), composited with local resolution weighting over the year's summer window on the 10 m MGRS grid. Linear power. For display, the collection's renders declare the decibel conversion, 10*log10.

rtc_vv_qa_num.title: Backscatter VV – Contributing Observations
rtc_vv_qa_num.description: Number of acquisitions that contributed to the Backscatter VV composite with a non-zero resolution weight.

items.title: STAC-GeoParquet item mirror
items.description: Every item of every year, one row each. The item JSON in the tree is the normative representation; this is the one to query.

table:columns.name: type
table:columns.description: Always `Feature`.

table:columns.name: stac_version
table:columns.description: STAC version of the item.

table:columns.name: stac_extensions
table:columns.description: Schema URIs of the STAC extensions the item uses.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Item id, `{mgrs_tile}-{year}`, such as `32TMS55-2024`.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Footprint of the MGRS square in WGS84 (EPSG:4326), as WKB: its four corners.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.description: Bounds of the footprint in WGS84. The GeoParquet covering column, with statistics per row group, so a bounding-box filter skips row groups.

table:columns.name: links
table:columns.description: The item document's links, with absolute hrefs: root, collection, parent and the CEOS-ARD specification.

table:columns.name: assets
table:columns.description: One struct per asset key, with absolute https hrefs. An asset a tile lacks, such as coherence on the 2015 gap tiles, is null.

table:columns.name: collection
table:columns.description: Id of the collection, `glace-{scope}-tiles`.

table:columns.name: start_datetime
table:columns.description: First day of the year's compositing window, at 00:00 UTC.

table:columns.name: end_datetime
table:columns.description: The day after the window's last day, at 00:00 UTC.

table:columns.name: constellation
table:columns.description: Always `sentinel-1`.

table:columns.name: instruments
table:columns.description: Always `[c-sar]`.

table:columns.name: sar:instrument_mode
table:columns.description: Always `IW`, Interferometric Wide swath.

table:columns.name: sar:frequency_band
table:columns.description: Always `C`.

table:columns.name: sar:polarizations
table:columns.description: Polarizations with at least one composite, `VV` and `VH`.

table:columns.name: version
table:columns.description: Dataset version the item belongs to.

table:columns.name: glace:mgrs_tile
table:columns.description: The 10 km MGRS square, such as `32TMS55`.

table:columns.name: grid:code
table:columns.description: The MGRS square in the STAC grid extension's form, `MGRS-32TMS55`.

table:columns.name: mgrs:utm_zone
table:columns.description: UTM zone of the square.

table:columns.name: mgrs:latitude_band
table:columns.description: MGRS latitude band of the square.

table:columns.name: mgrs:grid_square
table:columns.description: MGRS 100 km grid square identifier, the two letters after the band.

table:columns.name: proj:code
table:columns.description: CRS of the item's rasters, the square's UTM zone, such as `EPSG:32632`.

table:columns.name: proj:shape
table:columns.description: Raster shape of the item's COGs, `[rows, columns]`.

table:columns.name: proj:transform
table:columns.description: Affine transform of the item's COGs, six coefficients in `proj:code` units.

table:columns.name: glace:coh_first_acquisition
table:columns.description: Date of the first acquisition in the square's coherence composites, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

table:columns.name: glace:coh_last_acquisition
table:columns.description: Date of the last acquisition in the square's coherence composites. About twelve days before the last backscatter date, because both images of a pair must fall in the window.

table:columns.name: glace:rtc_first_acquisition
table:columns.description: Date of the first acquisition in the square's backscatter composites.

table:columns.name: glace:rtc_last_acquisition
table:columns.description: Date of the last acquisition in the square's backscatter composites.

table:columns.name: glace:glacier_fraction
table:columns.description: Share of the square inside RGI7-C-11 glacier outlines, 0 to 1. The same every year.

table:columns.name: glace:glacier_fraction_buffered
table:columns.description: Share of the square inside the same outlines buffered by 250 m, 0 to 1. The same every year.

table:columns.name: processing:level
table:columns.description: Always `L3`, a composite over many acquisitions.

table:columns.name: glace:dem
table:columns.description: DEM used for terrain correction and geocoding.

table:columns.name: datetime
table:columns.description: Midpoint of the compositing window.

grid.title: Tile grid with glacier fractions
grid.description: Every MGRS tile of any year as a polygon in the vector layer mgrs, with the properties mgrs_tile, glacier_fraction and glacier_fraction_buffered: the share of the tile covered by RGI7-C-11 outlines, plain and buffered by 250 m.

style-grid.title: Map style – tile grid
style-grid.description: Draws the tile grid, each tile filled by its buffered glacier fraction.
